preRecorded.title: What is a Pre-Recorded Video Interview?
preRecorded.intro: Instead of waiting for a club to schedule a call, you record a short video answering key professional questions at your own pace, in your own time. Clubs and academies watch your video before they even contact you. That means when they reach out, they already know who you are. No cold applications. No waiting. Just direct opportunities from clubs that are already interested in you.
preRecorded.bullet: Get shortlisted, get noticed and get hired faster than ever before

dreamTeam.op1: Create your professional profile and get discovered by clubs, agents and scouts worldwide
dreamTeam.op2: Upload your highlight videos and let your game speak for itself
dreamTeam.op3: Apply to job listings across professional and amateur levels globally
dreamTeam.op4: Players — Connect with clubs, agents and coaches to open doors at every level of the game
dreamTeam.op5: Staff — Whether you are a coach, fitness trainer, analyst or scout, build your professional profile and record your pre-recorded video interview so clubs and academies can find you based on your expertise and experience
